title: Cardedeu · Nuria's street
description: Cardedeu from OpenStreetMap (just geo cardedeu) with what the map lacks drawn by hand from the aerial reference: Nuria's long two-storey block with its terracotta roof on Carrer de Jacint Verdaguer, the white-roofed house on the Doctor Daurella corner, the houses and gardens across the street, and the R4 station a short walk away.
